description_full: Mabuchi Motor Co., Ltd. manufacture and sale of small motors in Japan, Europe, and North America, and internationally. It offers small electric motors for use in automotive appliances, light electric vehicles, precision and office equipment, home appliances, power tools, and medical products. Mabuchi Motor Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Matsudo, Japan.

financial_summary: MABUCHI MOTOR CO is a mid-cap consumer cyclical business with a $2.2B market cap on $1.3B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +4% over the past three years, which puts it in mature, slow-growth territory.
Returns on capital run at 6% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, with gross margins sitting at 26%.

The business throws off $223M in free cash flow — roughly 18 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.35× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Shareholder yield of 4.7% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 28% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and within its sector the business captures 1.5× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
